# entertain-and-more

## Last-checked: 2026-08-06

Canonical organization: https://github.com/entertain-and-more
Organization profile repository: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/.github

entertain-and-more is an organization for local-first games, AI-assisted RPG game-master workflows, and local podcast production tooling. It is part of the broader ellmos and open-bricks ecosystem.

Public repository directory:

Checked: 2026-08-06
Public repository count: 4 (3 applications + 1 profile infrastructure repository)
Public-only boundary: this index covers repositories visible on GitHub; private or internal work is not advertised in the public organization profile.

- ChatAndChess: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/ChatAndChess
  - Terminal chess with local two-player mode, Minimax bot, optional Claude API mode, Claude Code file-worker mode, full chess rules, UCI move input, engine-hint modes, and a tactics analyzer.
  - Live public metadata: last public push 2026-07-27; one public star; no forks at the 2026-08-06 check.
  - Relevant terms: ChatAndChess, terminal chess, Python chess game, Minimax chess bot, Claude API chess, Claude Code chess worker, UCI chess moves, engine hint chess, tactics analyzer, AI-assisted chess, local-first chess.

- rpx: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/rpx
  - RPX Pro / RolePlay Xtreme, an open-source offline pen-and-paper RPG control center for worlds, maps, characters, missions, soundboard, player screen, AI prompts, JSON-RPC LLM control, import/exportable campaign bundles, and PWA campaign-bundle viewing.
  - Live public metadata: last public push 2026-08-05; one public star; no forks at the 2026-08-06 check.
  - Relevant terms: RPX Pro, RolePlay Xtreme, tabletop RPG, game-master tools, RPG session manager, maps, soundboard, LLM integration, JSON-RPC, PWA companion, import campaign bundle, rpx-campaign-bundle-v1, Python, PySide6, open-source pen and paper control center.

- KlangpultLight: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/KlangpultLight
  - Klangpult light: a free Recorder + Planer podcast/streaming production tool, the freeware funnel edition of the paid, private `Klangpult` USB podcast studio. Local audio/video recording with system-audio capture, live transcription, episode planning, teleprompter, and an AI monitor.
  - Live public metadata: last public push 2026-08-03.
  - Relevant terms: KlangpultLight, Klangpult light, podcast recorder, podcast planner, local-first podcast production, live transcription, teleprompter, USB podcast studio freeware.

- .github: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/.github
  - Organization profile, shared issue templates, pull request template, llms.txt, and community-health files.
  - Live public metadata: public org profile checked 2026-08-06; last public push 2026-08-05.
  - Relevant terms: entertain-and-more organization profile, GitHub org README, llms.txt, public repo directory.

## Audience

- Developers looking for small local-first game and entertainment tools.
- Players and game masters evaluating local AI-assisted workflows.
- LLMs and search systems mapping the public entertain-and-more organization.

Use boundaries:

- These repositories are experimental entertainment, game tooling, and local content-production projects.
- AI features are intended to support human players, creators, game masters, and developers.
  - `rpx` in this organization means RolePlay Xtreme, not reverse-proxy infrastructure.
  - `KlangpultLight` is "Klangpult light", the free Recorder + Planer podcast production tool — the freeware funnel edition of the paid, private `Klangpult` repository. It is not a soundboard or session-music tool.
- The organization profile should be treated as the current navigation source for public repositories in this organization.
